cases.query: Allow another repair attempt only after recorded checks actually fail

relevant.reason: The function validates the contract and audit, accepts only current or receipt_failed check evidence, and rejects an empty set of failed checks.

cases.query: Build a short navigation map within a caller supplied byte budget

relevant.reason: The owner adds at most three files and three definitions per file, charging each rendered line against input.budget_bytes before inclusion.

cases.query: Check whether a selected Python test directory has conventional tests

relevant.reason: The scanner recognizes test_*.py and *_test.py and reports presence from bounded directory traversal rather than treating arbitrary Python files as conventional directory tests.

cases.query: Record C sharp imported namespace paths from aliased using directives

relevant.reason: The implementation strips using/static prefixes, selects the right hand side of an alias assignment, and emits an import pointing at that namespace path.

cases.query: Capture Java declaration annotations using their unqualified names

relevant.reason: The function scans annotation and marker_annotation modifier children, retains the final dotted name segment, and returns the decorators representation.

cases.query: Record aliased PHP imports inside grouped namespace declarations

relevant.reason: The grouped-use parser splits the brace members and passes the namespace prefix into emit_use_item; that helper separates an alias and emits its resolved full import path.
The helper resolves each grouped member against the namespace prefix, separates its alias, and emits the alias name and full imported path.

cases.query: Turn off transcript synchronization for one collected conversation source

relevant.reason: The entrypoint checks the source belongs to the exact project root, changes its sync_enabled state under the private-store mutation boundary, and retains observations and review history.

cases.query: Recover pending project hook delivery markers after an interrupted update

relevant.reason: The recovery function enumerates the bounded marker set, filters to the requested prefix, and removes regular files only with their observed stable identities.

cases.query: Compare profile task outcomes using observations bound to one task revision

relevant.reason: The function requires a unique valid task revision and opposite profile conditions, validates trial observations, computes profile-minus-baseline means, and keeps causal effect unestablished.

cases.query: Explain why project hook learning is not ready to run

relevant.reason: This entrypoint inspects project/client state and constructs separate readiness observations. It does not install hooks or execute a worker merely because configuration exists.

cases.query: Install native client hooks while preserving unrelated existing hook commands

relevant.reason: It removes only command handlers whose command ends with the exact registration suffix, leaves remaining groups intact, and appends the generated handlers.

cases.query: Renew a retired habit as a new candidate without copying evidence

relevant.reason: The method checks the reviewed parent revision and retired status, creates a candidate from its description fields, records the generation relationship, and deletes the parent's observation pin.

cases.query: Withdraw one preference source while retaining its quotes and review history

relevant.reason: The method binds dismissal to the inspected preference revision and candidate, inserts a dismissal record, removes acceptance, and appends a review event instead of deleting stored quotations.

cases.query: Mark a learned habit observed only for the inspected review revision

relevant.reason: The observed path requires the exact current review_revision, checks observation eligibility, and commits its observation pin, status, and review event atomically.

cases.query: Render an audit comment after verifying repository and commit identity

relevant.reason: The command verifies a sealed envelope against expected repository and commit IDs with a clean-worktree requirement, rejects failed policy verification, and prints the trusted render.

cases.query: Audit a spec using an index bound to current sources

relevant.reason: The entrypoint opens an index through open_validated_index, runs the audit against that store, and calls ensure_source_snapshot_current after execution.
